title: Drift Wood #4 · the back page
logline: Chloe gives him the back page. She wants something for it.

panels.composition: The newsroom. The paste-up board for the next issue. CHLOE tapes a blank rectangle to the back page. WOOD watching.

characters.pose: taping a blank rectangle to a layout board

image.prompt: a teenage girl with heavy eyeliner taping a blank rectangle onto a newspaper paste-up board while a boy in an overcoat watches, school newsroom, light table

balloons.text: I accept. The back page is where the real readers go first.

image.prompt: close-up of a teenage boy with his hand on his chest accepting something graciously

balloons.text: The back page is where the ads didn't sell.

image.prompt: a teenage girl with her back turned working at a paste-up board, deadpan

panels.composition: Wood alone with the blank rectangle. He has drawn a very small gull in the corner of it already.

characters.pose: leaning over the board, pen out

props: the blank rectangle with a tiny gull in the corner

image.prompt: a teenage boy leaning over a paste-up board drawing a tiny gull in the corner of an empty rectangle, newsroom lamp light

notes: Origin of the back page, and of the gull as a habit.
